title: The coord hook posts an intent for any Bash text that holds 'backlog.py claim ID', a commit message or echo included
goal: SP-xo45jvbj review G6 (ST-x6mvfnmv): the CLAIM regex of coord_hook.py matches inside a commit message, echo, grep or heredoc, and the intent is posted before the claim runs, so a refused claim also leaves one; other sessions then see an intent for an item nobody works on. Only a command that runs backlog.py claim posts an intent, and a refused claim leaves none.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite'))
E.pop('KB_COORD_URL',None)
H=os.path.abspath('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');T=os.path.abspath('_tools/coord.py')
def repo(n,b):
    r=os.path.join(D,n);s.run(['git','init','-q','-b',b,r],check=True);s.run(['git','-C',r,'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','i'],check=True);return r
def hook(cwd,**p):
    p.setdefault('cwd',cwd);return s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps(p),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=cwd,timeout=60).stdout
def c(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=300)
r=repo('r','main')
hook(r,hook_event_name='PreToolUse',session_id='repro-'+os.urandom(4).hex(),tool_name='Bash',tool_input={'command':'git commit -m "mention backlog.py claim ST-zzzzzzzz in text"'})
o=c('digest','--key','ST-zzzzzzzz','--lines','5').stdout
print(repr(o));sys.exit(0 if 'ST-zzzzzzzz' not in o else 1)

notes: Hygiene 2026-10-17: the old repro passed on origin/main 3dba0ef83 only because SessionEnd now releases the session's intents; the CLAIM regex still posts an intent for a commit message that holds backlog.py claim ID. The repro now reads the digest before the session ends, under a fresh session id (the hook keeps per-session state in the clone's _cache/coord_hook).
